chunks: O you who believe, God will surely try you with the game that you take with your hands or your lances, in order to know who fear Him unseen. Whosoever transgress after this will suffer grievous punishment.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on hunting during Hajj in Islam?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Ma'idah (5:94) establishes the prohibition of hunting while in the state of Ihram as a divine test to distinguish those who truly fear God by their obedience to the unseen command. It warns that transgressing this boundary after the prohibition is made clear results in a painful punishment, emphasizing the spiritual discipline required during the pilgrimage rituals.
